name: ProtocolQA
intro: ProtocolQA是LAB-Bench中的135题无工具多项选择子任务，用于评估模型理解研究实验方案、解释假想负面结果并提出改进措施的能力。生物学专家从protocols.io和STAR Protocols提取方案并注入明确破坏实验结果的错误，再由另一批专家核验并撰写故障排除题。
build_method: 两轮生物学专家从protocols.io与STAR Protocols提取方案、注入错误、交叉核验并撰写故障排除选择题
eval_feature: 零样本思维链、随机选项顺序、信息不足拒答项、正则与Claude 2回退解析，并以20题开放回答子集复核
scale: 135道题；约80%公开、20%私留用于污染监测
build_method_en: Two rounds of biology experts extract protocols.io and STAR Protocols procedures, inject errors, cross-check the failure scenario, and draft troubleshooting MCQs
eval_feature_en: Zero-shot CoT, randomized options, an insufficient-information choice, regex plus Claude 2 fallback parsing, and a 20-item open-response validation subset
intro_en: ProtocolQA is the 135-question, tool-free multiple-choice subtask in LAB-Bench. It evaluates whether models can understand a research protocol, interpret a hypothetical negative result, and propose an improvement. Biology experts extract procedures from protocols.io and STAR Protocols and inject errors that clearly damage the result, then additional experts validate the scenario and draft troubleshooting questions.
scale_en: 135 questions; approximately 80% public and 20% private for contamination monitoring
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已按LAB-Bench论文与官方仓库核对两轮专家流程、protocols.io与STAR Protocols来源、错误注入与核验、135题而非全库2,457题、约80/20公开私留、零样本CoT、拒答选项、两级解析、Accuracy/Precision/Coverage及20题开放回答验证，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
